answer: Nonce-bound work receipts. Each identity must submit a freshly solved random challenge whose solution is embedded in the transaction, so any replay is rejected as hollow. Validators require the receipt to clear a rising difficulty ledge tied to recent identity creation, making mass registration progressively costlier in compute per identity. At the zenith of demand, an attacker pays the full marginal electricity and hardware time for every puppet, with no reuse across identities.
